independentAudit.collectorFailure: Expected selector instead of css-selector; unexecuted traversal also assumed an array rather than one JSON root. Original collector and artifacts preserved.
independentAudit.scope: source tags/attributes/order/text, not inferred header associations or computed layout

review.review_type: offline saved-native-content review; not a new native test

method.scope: Complete paragraph inventory in both assigned article-body regions, all article headings/list items/table cells/code blocks/reference entries and effective links; not a sample, not every text node in the full source document.
method.tools: Python standard library only; local bounded parsing and assertions; Python 3.8-compatible syntax.
method.html: Strict UTF-8 decode of validated base64 bodyCapture.data; HTMLParser(convert_charrefs=True), explicit element stack and void tags, end tags close back to matching opener. Source tree inventory, not an HTML5 browser tree or layout implementation.
method.css_limit: No computed CSS or class-based visibility inferred; class tokens only identify the explicit paragraph-like wrappers. No page scripts or CSS executed.
method.source_text_normalization: Concatenate eligible descendant data in source order; br becomes newline; HTML entities decoded by HTMLParser; collapse Python Unicode whitespace with re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip(); preserve case, punctuation and all remaining Unicode characters. Select strictly more than 80 normalized characters.
method.markdown_normalization: Preserve inline code payloads while removing delimiters and one paired padding space where applicable; use visible inline-link labels; remove Markdown heading/list markers and bold delimiters; decode backslash punctuation escapes and HTML entities outside code; restore code; collapse Unicode whitespace. No word/punctuation deletion or fuzzy matching.
method.matching: Every selected paragraph must be an exact normalized contiguous substring in source order and in exactly one blank-line-delimited Markdown block; hashes are SHA-256 of normalized UTF-8. Compare complete heading sequences with levels, numbered reference label sequences, table row/cell sequences, preformatted code except outer newlines, and effective link label/destination multiplicities.
method.nested_citation_anchors: Count the outermost anchor once where captured malformed HTML nests duplicate citation anchors; do not count the repeated nested wrapper as another rendered citation. Verify all effective label/destination occurrences and all distinct raw pairs.
method.url_resolution: Resolve source href values against saved finalUrl using urllib.parse.urljoin, only as local string processing; never follow links.
method.section_selection: Use the exact selector recorded in each assigned INVOCATION.json; compare selected h2 and subsequent sibling subtrees up to, but excluding, next h1/h2, including intervening h3 and their content.
method.hash_checks: Recompute original receipt/page/body sizes and SHA-256 against RESULT and bodyCapture/primaryResponse; section replay/stdout against EXECUTION and source pins against the same receipt/body. Parent transport/process/source-build audits not repeated.
